summary: Iter 84 — Drove full end-to-end kiosk payment flow (admin re-seeded Anita with app_role=kiosk + PIN 4321, kiosk-pin login, injected kiosk_token into localStorage, pay cash on an existing invoice) and verified ReceiptScreen (KioskLayout.jsx FittedReceiptPreview + ReceiptScreen) under three real browser configurations. ALL 4 user requirements for the receipt page are met: (1) No scrolling at mobile viewports — at BOTH 390x844 (iPhone UA) and 375x667 (iPhone SE UA) document.scrollingElement.scrollHeight == innerHeight (844/667, no overflow); every one of receipt-thanks, receipt-card, receipt-preview-iframe, receipt-remaining-row, receipt-done, receipt-ktp-print, receipt-manual-print and receipt-paper has its bounding box fully inside the viewport. (2) receipt-paper is perfectly centered horizontally in receipt-card: left_gap==right_gap (0.0px diff; 73.5/73.5 at 390 and 91.2/91.2 at 375). (3) No automatic print dialog and no AudioContext creation after reaching the receipt on iPhone UA — spies window.print and window.AudioContext (constructor wrapped via add_init_script before page scripts load) show printAfterReceipt=0 and audioAfterReceipt=0 across the full 5+ seconds on the receipt screen for BOTH iPhone viewports. On DESKTOP UA (Windows Chrome, 1366x900) auto-print IS called once (~3s) after reaching receipt → printAfterReceipt=1. (4) 'Afdruk' button (data-testid=receipt-manual-print) when clicked triggers window.print (printCalls 0 -> 1). It sits next to 'Print via KT-V520' in the SAME row (both at y=755.5 at 390x844 and y=578 at 375x667). The iframe body text contains the actual receipt (KW2026-00572/573/574, 'SuriRent N.V.', KWITANTIE, 'Jan Pieterse', 'Huur — Augustus 2026') — definitely NOT 'Kwitantie niet gevonden'.
critical_code_review_comments: FittedReceiptPreview onLoad relies on iframe.contentDocument access — sandbox='allow-same-origin' makes this work, confirmed sizes correctly (contentDocument.body.innerText shows full receipt). Note: console shows 'Blocked script execution ... frame is sandboxed and allow-scripts not set' — harmless (print.html has no critical scripts in preview mode) but noisy; could be silenced by hosting print.html as pure HTML, not critical.

KioskLayout.jsx ReceiptScreen auto-print guard L2648: /iPhone|iPad|iPod|Android/i.test(navigator.userAgent) — correct; verified NO window.print on iPhone UA within 5s and DOES fire on desktop UA ~3s. Clean.

FittedReceiptPreview uses ResizeObserver + CSS transform:scale — scales both axes with Math.min(1, box.h/size.h, box.w/size.w). Works but transformOrigin:'top left' + a wrapper sized to size.w*scale,size.h*scale → double-scaling is fine; verified visually at both 390 and 375 viewports.
receipt-ktp-print wraps KtpPrintButton in a div with flex-1 — renders equal width next to Afdruk on both mobile sizes; no overflow seen.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 4 user requirements verified at 390x844, 375x667, and desktop 1366x900)

Then assert bounding boxes of receipt-thanks/card/preview-iframe/remaining-row/done/ktp-print/manual-print/paper are inside the viewport and scrollHeight<=innerHeight. For centering: cb.x+cb.width-paper.right ≈ paper.left-cb.x. For spies: window.__printAfterReceipt and __audioAfterReceipt should both be 0 on iPhone UA, printAfterReceipt>=1 on desktop UA.
rca of the issue: n/a — iter 84 is a verification pass; no bugs found. The four user requirements (no scroll, centered paper, no auto-print/sound on mobile, Afdruk button) are all correctly implemented in KioskLayout.jsx FittedReceiptPreview + ReceiptScreen.
